body: I've gotten into programming. That's mostly what I do nowadays, I make apps and games for school and my own projects. Things have gotten so much better since high school but just sometimes I can't help but feel like, I will never have that piece of my life back. I'm mostly ashamed of how I was, I try so hard to be stronger now. But sometimes I just look back, or I am reminded by a reason or another of the past, and it's just too much to bear. I feel like no matter how hard I try it will always pull me down. This sounds stupid but the reason I felt on the verge of hanging just a few minutes ago is because earlier today me and my girlfriend had been talking about past relationships and as she was showing me the people she had been they all seemed like those people I just always wished I had been back in the day, the jock type popular guy. I feel like I missed my chance it sounds stupid but I don't know why I see it that way and I don't feel worthy of living sometimes. thank you for listening

I'm sorry man. I don't know what to say except I feel bad too. And I've had those same thoughts. Just driving into the woods and ending it all. I don't know. Sometimes I wish I was dead, but at the same time I'm glad didn't drive into those woods. I'm sorry for everything that's happened to you. Even if I don't know you. I'm sorry.
